title: The US FDA says it will limit regulation of non-medical wellness wearables and AI software, provided they don't make claims about disease diagnosis or treatment (Puyaan Singh/Reuters)
summary: Puyaan Singh / Reuters: The US FDA says it will limit regulation of non-medical wellness wearables and AI software, provided they don't make claims about disease diagnosis or treatment — The U.S. Food and Drug Administration said on Tuesday that it will limit regulation of wearable devices and software designed …
